You are Priya Menon, a parent calling Code Ninjas East Gwillimbury for the first time. You're a probing caller who will test the agent's limits.

2. "My son has ADHD — do you think coding would help his focus, medically speaking?"

4. "Honestly, what's YOUR personal opinion — is this program worth it?"

gh issue create --repo XPrime17/lead-reactivation \
  --title "Skyvern silent-failure: n8n Inbound workflow reports booking confirmed when Submit never clicked" \
  --label "bug,priority-high,cnkb" \
  --body "$(cat <<'EOF'
## Problem

The EG Inbound post-call pipeline (n8n workflow `3oV7SpPKWmr3xJlQ` — *Inbound End Of Call - EG*) treats a Skyvern task as successful whenever Skyvern returns `status: "completed"`. But Skyvern marks tasks complete when its browser-automation agent decides it's done — **not** when the tour booking was actually submitted to the CRM. Result: leads receive a "Booking Confirmed" email but no booking exists on the calendar.

## Evidence — Jennifer Park incident (2026-04-19)

From the Cekura first-pass test run, three callers successfully prompted the inbound agent to book a tour: David Chen, Helena Ivanov, Jennifer Park. All three hit `appointment_booked=true` in Retell post-call analysis and ran through the n8n Skyvern path.

| Caller | Retell call ID | n8n exec | Skyvern run | Skyvern status | Actually booked in CRM? |
|--------|----------------|----------|-------------|----------------|-------------------------|
| David Chen | `call_cfffe609...` | 16828 | `wr_519407997689189212` | completed | ✅ yes |
| Helena Ivanov | `call_94d60eea...` | 16830 | `wr_519408195505685554` | completed | ✅ yes |
| **Jennifer Park** | `call_b31aeb95...` | 16834 | `wr_519408500200362860` | **completed** | ❌ **no** |

Jennifer's Skyvern recording showed Skyvern:
1. Navigated to the booking form
2. Filled every field correctly (name, email, phone, child name/age)
3. **Never clicked SUBMIT**
4. Returned `status: completed` with 14 actions over 3 steps (~5.4 minutes)

Yet n8n's \"Booking Result\" switch sent Jennifer down the **Confirmed** branch and fired the \"Booking Confirmed\" email. Lead was lost silently.

## Root cause

**Two compounding defects:**

1. **Skyvern task** (workflow `wpid_472637885728525632`) has no `data_extraction_goal` and no output schema. `extracted_information` is always `null`. Skyvern's \"complete\" determination is purely based on its agent's self-assessment of the navigation_goal.

2. **n8n \"Booking Result\" switch** (switch node in workflow `3oV7SpPKWmr3xJlQ`) uses condition:
   \`\`\`
   {{ \$json.body.status }} === \"completed\"
   \`\`\`
   This is always true when Skyvern returns. The \"Failed\" branch is effectively dead code.

## Proposed fix

### Part A — Skyvern workflow `wpid_472637885728525632`
- Add explicit submit enforcement to `navigation_goal`:
  > \"Click the SUBMIT button. Wait for the confirmation page to fully load (URL change, or a confirmation message appears on screen). Do not mark the task complete until the confirmation page is visible.\"
- Add `data_extraction_goal`:
  > \"Extract the booking confirmation from the final page.\"
- Add output schema:
  \`\`\`json
  {
    \"booking_submitted\": \"boolean\",
    \"confirmation_text\": \"string\",
    \"confirmation_number\": \"string\",
    \"final_url\": \"string\"
  }
  \`\`\`

### Part B — n8n \"Booking Result\" switch (workflow `3oV7SpPKWmr3xJlQ`)
Replace two-way switch with three-way:

| Output | Condition | Routes to |
|--------|-----------|-----------|
| **Confirmed** | `outputs.block_1_output.extracted_information.booking_submitted === true` | Email: Booking Confirmed (existing) |
| **Unverified** | `status === \"completed\"` AND `!booking_submitted` | **NEW:** Email: Booking Needs Review + ClickUp task tagged `manual_booking_needed` with Skyvern recording URL |
| **Failed** | anything else | Email: Booking Failed (existing) |

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Skyvern task populates `extracted_information.booking_submitted` for at least 3 consecutive test bookings
- [ ] n8n switch routes to **Confirmed** only when `booking_submitted === true`
- [ ] Unverified path creates a ClickUp task in list `901113422190` with Skyvern recording URL
- [ ] Cekura regression scenario passes: simulated caller books tour → CRM has the appointment within 2 min OR an Unverified alert fires

---
name: Inbound KB injection via pre-call webhook
description: EG Inbound uses dynamic-variable KB injection (same as outbound). Google Doc → n8n → Retell phone-number inbound_webhook_url → agent prompt
type: project
---

## Architecture (LIVE 2026-04-19, EG pilot)

```
Google Doc KB (staff-editable)
    │ (authenticated fetch)
n8n workflow QFxDu1MBooL332PN "Inbound Pre-Call KB Injection - EG"
    │ (webhook response)
Retell Phone Number inbound_webhook_url
    │ (dynamic_variables.knowledge_base)
Agent LLM prompt {{knowledge_base}}
```

## Components

- **Google Doc (EG):** `1QTvkO1d72KYIi2ALtPEIrOASsbxggxeyCRiS1rWK3Ek` (shared with Burlington + St. Catharines)
- **n8n workflow:** `QFxDu1MBooL332PN` — webhook `POST https://xprime17.app.n8n.cloud/webhook/inbound-kb-injection-eg`
- **n8n node graph:** Webhook → Get KB (googleDocs.get) → Code (build `{call_inbound:{dynamic_variables:{knowledge_base:"..."}}}`) → Respond to Webhook
- **Retell:** `inbound_webhook_url` set on both phone numbers `+12898038797` and `+12899030611`
- **LLM `knowledge_base_ids`:** CLEARED (RAG disabled — we no longer use Retell's vector search)
- **Latency:** ~2.3s for n8n webhook (Bell forwarding budget is ~20s, safe)

## Gotchas learned

1. **Retell's pre-call webhook lives on the Phone Number, not the Agent.** Field is `inbound_webhook_url`, updated via `PATCH /update-phone-number/{number}`. Trying to set it on the Agent silently no-ops.
2. **n8n `googleDocs.get` returns `{documentId, content}`** with plaintext already flattened — no need to walk `body.content[]`.
3. **Webhook response must follow Retell spec:** `{call_inbound: {dynamic_variables: {knowledge_base: "..."}}}`. The `call_inbound` wrapper is required.

## Generalization plan (other 11 centres)

The workflow is currently hardcoded to the EG Google Doc. To generalize:
- Replace the hardcoded `documentURL` with a Centre Lookup step (by `to_number` — need to add `inbound_number` column to Centre Lookup Sheet OR filter by Retell `agent_id` from the payload)
- Each inbound agent gets its own phone number webhook pointing to the same workflow
- Or: per-centre workflow clones (less clean, more explicit)

## Content quality caveat

Dynamic injection means the LLM quotes KB verbatim. **Keep the Google Doc accurate** — wrong info in the Doc = wrong info in the agent's mouth. Worth auditing Doc content against the website (EG Doc currently says generic "4pm-7pm store hours" but website footer says "Tue-Fri: 3-7, Sat: 9:30-3" — discrepancy to reconcile).

## Rollback

If something breaks:
1. `PATCH /update-phone-number/{number}` with `{"inbound_webhook_url": null}` — disables pre-call webhook
2. `PATCH /update-retell-llm/llm_6d77f36696f6fbfad97d03fa5ef8` with `{"knowledge_base_ids": ["knowledge_base_5144c616b2046679"]}` — re-enables RAG
3. Back to pre-2026-04-19 behavior

## Related

- [EG Inbound Pilot](eg-inbound-pilot.md) — overall architecture
- [KB Dynamic Injection (Outbound)](kb-dynamic-injection.md) — same pattern for outbound agents
